licenses.MIT-0: MIT without the attribution clause; strictly more permissive than MIT. Currently dev-only (@csstools/* via jsdom).
licenses.Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception: Apache-2.0 plus the LLVM exception, which only grants extra permissions. Currently build-time only (@bytecodealliance/* via the Paraglide/inlang toolchain).

@lix-js/sdk-*.reason: Per-platform native binaries of @lix-js/sdk (MIT). Their package.json lacks a license field; the upstream repo github.com/opral/lix is MIT. Build-time only (Paraglide/inlang).
